content.title: The Score: Lululemon, Tesla, Delta, Nike and More Stocks That Defined the Week
content.summary: Chip Wilson said Monday that he had nominated three director candidates to the board as Lululemon searches for a new chief executive, confirming an earlier report by The Wall Street Journal.
